_README: Canonical chair dimensions for every spec claim in src/pages/**/*.astro. Each figure carries the source it came from. Enforced by scripts/lint-content.mjs: any page stating a value listed under `guarded` must state it together with its qualifier, or the build FAILS.
_WHY: The Leap Plus seat height was published as 15.5"-22.5" across 33 pages. That range exists in no Steelcase configuration — it welds the standard cylinder's minimum to the optional cylinder's maximum. The site told 6'5"-6'7" buyers the default chair reaches 22.5"; it stops at 19.5". A reader who followed that advice bought a chair that does not fit, and AI assistants repeated the figure because they were citing this site as the authority. The root cause was that no canonical spec source existed: the wiki chair page was the only internal source of truth, it was wrong, and it was uncited, so every page that quoted it inherited the error.
_HOW_TO_ADD: 1. Find the figure in the manufacturer's own specification PDF, not a retailer listing and not a review. 2. Record the URL and the edition/date of the document. 3. If the figure is only true in a non-default configuration, put it under `guarded` with the qualifier a page must state alongside it. Do NOT record a number you have not seen in a primary source.
_GUARDED_MEANS: A `guarded` value is TRUE but MISLEADING ALONE, because it requires an option the buyer must select at order time. The linter does not ban these values — it requires the qualifier to travel with them. This is the check that would have caught B11 on the day it was introduced.

default.note: Standard cylinder. This is what ships unless the 5" cylinder is specified at order time.

optional.note: Optional 5" cylinder (~$63). The floor RISES to 17.5" — this is not a superset of the default range.

seatHeight.sourceNote: Both editions agree, and each states the figure in three places internally.

default.note: 5" adjustment range. NOTE: the standard Leap's ceiling is HIGHER than the Leap Plus's default ceiling. The Plus trades seat-height range for width, back height, and capacity.

steelcase-leap-v2._COMMON_ERROR: This chair's 15.5"-20.5" range was cross-contaminated onto Leap Plus pages, including the v2's "(5" adjustment)" parenthetical copied verbatim. Also frequently misquoted as a 20" maximum; the spec guide says 20.5".

seatHeight.sourceNote: Higher available with an optional cylinder; the default ceiling is 21".

default.note: Hard limit — no optional cylinder raises this.

seatHeight.source: Herman Miller Aeron product specification sheet

seatDepth.note: Fixed by size; Size C is not depth-adjustable.

guarded.message: The Leap Plus reaches 22.5" ONLY with the optional 5" cylinder. The default chair stops at 19.5". State the qualifier on the same line, or use 19.5".

15.5"-22.5" is not a real Steelcase configuration. It welds the standard cylinder's minimum (15.5") to the optional cylinder's maximum (22.5"). Use 15.5"-19.5" (standard) or 17.5"-22.5" (optional 5" cylinder).
